in_greek.name: Σοφέλια
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Σοφία είναι η φύση της σοφίας, ενώ η Έλεος είναι η φύση της αγάπης και της φιλανθρωπίας. Η συνδυασμένη σημασία του ονόματος Σοφέλια είναι η συνδυασμένη φύση της σοφίας και της αγάπης.

in_latin.name: Sophelia
in_latin.long_meaning: Sapientia significat sapientiam, quae est natura sapientiae, dum Clemens significat misericordiam et charitatem. Significatio coniuncta nominis Sophelia est coniunctio naturae sapientiae et misericordiae.

historical_references.reference: According to medieval European folklore, Sophelia was an angelic name given to a holy woman who lived in the 3rd century AD and was known for her extraordinary beauty and miraculous powers. She was said to have healed the sick, raised the dead, and performed other wonders. Her name was derived from the Greek word for wisdom, 'sophia'.

In the 17th century, a Portuguese nun named Maria de Jesus dos Anjos, who lived in the convent of Sainte-Catherine-du-Val-des-Prés in Paris, was given the name Sophelia by her fellow sisters due to her exceptional wisdom and piety. She was known for her profound spiritual insights and her ability to heal the sick. The name Sophelia was a variation of the Portuguese word for wisdom, 'sabedoria'.

In the context of neo-paganism, Sophelia is often used as a name for goddesses or spiritual entities in personal practices and circles. On Goodreads, Sophelia is the title of a popular fantasy novel by Mary Stewart. Lastly, within the cosplay community on DeviantArt, Sophelia is a name given to various character inspirations and representations, particularly in fantasy and mythology-themed cosplays.
